scope: Bounded resolution of known additional inventory scope notes: three Basque foral legislatures; Norwegian/Swedish Sámi institutions; Longyearbyen; Luxembourg Conseil d’État; RAEOA/Ataúro; Fernando de Noronha. Inventory/authority only.
user_scope: First-level and autonomous special-status legislatures; ordinary municipal and individual-community governments excluded.
common_basque_finding: The three historical territories are nested in the Basque Country but have a distinct protected foral regime, substantial territorial tax/normative authority and parliamentary budget/executive control. Under the user’s autonomous special-status scope, nesting alone does not exclude them. Law 27/1983 article 6(2) reserves formal Ley rank to the Basque Parliament; its article 8 separately recognises Juntas Normas Forales in exclusive fields, including substitution of Basque legislation. This decision does not equate every Norma Foral with an Act of the Basque Parliament.

records.name: Juntas Generales de Álava / Arabako Batzar Nagusiak
records.decision: Add this distinct foral territorial legislature under the autonomous special-status scope; retain its nesting under the Basque Country.
records.legislative_authority_finding: Shares the statute-protected territorial normative and tax regime explained in common_basque_finding; individual institutional provision identifies this organ.
records.budget_and_executive_control_finding: Own institutional text gives the Juntas territorial budget approval, election of the Diputado General and control of the foral executive.
scope_limits: Not an additional autonomous community or national chamber.
Formal Normas Forales do not all have rank of Ley; eligibility rests on substantive protected foral authority and executive/budget accountability.
Do not extend this finding to ordinary Spanish provincial deputations, cabildos or island councils without their own authority review.

records.decision: Add this distinct foral territorial legislature under the autonomous special-status scope; retain its nesting under the Basque Country.
records.legislative_authority_finding: Shares the statute-protected territorial normative and tax regime explained in common_basque_finding; individual institutional provision identifies this organ.
records.budget_and_executive_control_finding: Own institutional text gives the Juntas territorial budget approval, election of the Diputado General and control of the foral executive.
scope_limits: Not an additional autonomous community or national chamber.
Formal Normas Forales do not all have rank of Ley; eligibility rests on substantive protected foral authority and executive/budget accountability.
Do not extend this finding to ordinary Spanish provincial deputations, cabildos or island councils without their own authority review.

records.decision: Add this distinct foral territorial legislature under the autonomous special-status scope; retain its nesting under the Basque Country.
records.legislative_authority_finding: Shares the statute-protected territorial normative and tax regime explained in common_basque_finding; individual institutional provision identifies this organ.
records.budget_and_executive_control_finding: Own institutional text gives the Juntas territorial budget approval, election of the Diputado General and control of the foral executive.
scope_limits: Not an additional autonomous community or national chamber.
Formal Normas Forales do not all have rank of Ley; eligibility rests on substantive protected foral authority and executive/budget accountability.
Do not extend this finding to ordinary Spanish provincial deputations, cabildos or island councils without their own authority review.

records.name: Sámediggi / Sametinget (Sámi Parliament of Norway)
records.jurisdiction: Sámi people in Norway; nonterritorial representative jurisdiction
records.decision: Retain an explicit exclusion from first-level/autonomous territorial legislature inventory.
records.legislative_authority_finding: Statutory consultation, representation and specifically assigned decisions are substantial, but do not establish a general autonomous territorial lawmaking jurisdiction.
records.budget_and_executive_control_finding: Controls its internal administration and delegated Sámi-purpose funds; grant/flag regulations and elected organisation do not constitute territorial legislative government.
scope_limits: Do not describe it as powerless or merely informal consultation.
Sápmi cultural geography and language-administration areas are not a new territorial legislature boundary.

records.name: Sametinget (Sámi Parliament of Sweden)
records.jurisdiction: Sámi people in Sweden; nonterritorial representative jurisdiction
records.decision: Retain an explicit exclusion from first-level/autonomous territorial legislature inventory.
records.legislative_authority_finding: Current Sametingslag defines a special agency with Sámi cultural and assigned administrative/consultation tasks, rather than autonomous territorial legislative competence.
records.budget_and_executive_control_finding: Elected plenum chooses an accountable board and administers funds; those powers belong to the specified agency framework.
scope_limits: Distinct assessment from Finland/Norway; not an exclusion based on its name or Indigenous status.
Do not confuse actual public-authority decisions with general territorial lawmaking.

records.name: Longyearbyen lokalstyre / Longyearbyen Community Council
records.decision: Exclude this local council; do not invent a Svalbard-wide territorial parliament.
records.legislative_authority_finding: The chapter 5 local-government framework covers Longyearbyen’s planning area, with municipal-like services and regulation rather than autonomous Svalbard territorial legislation.
records.budget_and_executive_control_finding: Has meaningful local budget, service and administrative decisions, but remains within the excluded municipal tier.
scope_limits: Exclusion is by local tier and function, not by the term council.
Governor/central government administration of the archipelago is distinct from this elected local body.

records.name: Conseil d’État
records.decision: Record the role explicitly; do not add a second national parliamentary chamber.
records.legislative_authority_finding: Constitutional opinions and agreement to waive the Chamber’s second vote include a real suspensive power, but the Chamber retains law adoption.
records.budget_and_executive_control_finding: No separate territorial executive or budget-legislature relationship is established by this Council’s constitutional role.
scope_limits: Not excluded merely because unelected: the decisive point is its constitutional organ/function within a unicameral system.
Do not call its role purely consultative or claim it has no influence over enactment timing.

records.name: Autoridade da Região Administrativa Especial de Oe-Cusse Ambeno
records.jurisdiction: Região Administrativa Especial de Oe-Cusse Ambeno
records.decision: Record an administrative special region without an eligible regional parliament.
records.legislative_authority_finding: The operative 2026 decree identifies the Authority’s administrative deliberative class, applying municipal administrative competences; the founding framework excludes legislative autonomy.
records.budget_and_executive_control_finding: Authority/President manage supervised plans, budgets and expenditure; this is not parliamentary control by a separate representative legislature.
scope_limits: Special regional status and the term deliberative do not alone establish a parliament.
Use DL 1/2026; the repealed2015 organisational decree alone is insufficient.

records.name: Conselho Consultivo da Região Administrativa Especial de Oe-Cusse Ambeno
records.jurisdiction: Região Administrativa Especial de Oe-Cusse Ambeno
records.decision: Retain separately as a nonlegislative organ of the same region.
records.legislative_authority_finding: DL 1/2026 articles 14–17 expressly constitute a consultative council to the regional President, with municipal consultative-law functions.
records.budget_and_executive_control_finding: Consultation in supervised regional administration is not a separate legislative budget or executive confidence chamber.
scope_limits: Same special region as the Authority record; not another territory.

records.name: Conselho Geral da Autoridade Administrativa de Ataúro
records.decision: Retain an explicit administrative-authority exclusion, including its General Council.
records.legislative_authority_finding: DL 82/2023 gives administrative oversight and proposals to ministers, not an autonomous territorial legislative power.
records.budget_and_executive_control_finding: General Council approves plans/budgets subject to ministerial homologation. Its supervisory power is real; central tutelage appoints sector representatives and directs the authority.
scope_limits: Do not describe the Council as merely ceremonial; it has administrative approval and scrutiny functions.
The ministerial oversight and local administrative class, rather than appointment alone, determine scope.

records.name: Conselho Distrital de Fernando de Noronha
records.jurisdiction: Distrito Estadual de Fernando de Noronha
records.decision: Retain an explicit exclusion; Pernambuco’s state legislature supplies legislative authority.
records.legislative_authority_finding: Organic Law36–37 gives consultation/scrutiny and proposals through the administrator/state process; local street naming and internal resolutions do not establish regional lawmaking.
records.budget_and_executive_control_finding: Council approves accounts and reviews budget proposals, but district spending is in Pernambuco’s budget law; the governor appoints the administrator.
scope_limits: Election, account approval and public hearings are acknowledged; they do not by themselves make this a territorial legislature.
The separate environmental council CONDIMA is not the elected District Council.

basque-statute.instrument: Organic Law 3/1979, Basque Statute of Autonomy
basque-statute.finding: Protects the historical territories’ own foral institutions and exclusive competences, including their budgets; article 41 preserves territorial tax-regime powers.
basque-statute.currentness: Foundational statute read through official BOE text; no complete amendment census certified.

basque-territories-law.instrument: Basque Law 27/1983, relations between common institutions and foral organs
basque-territories-law.finding: Article6(2) reserves formal law rank to the Basque Parliament. Article8 separately recognises foral normative authority in exclusive fields, including replacement of Basque legislation through Juntas Normas Forales.
basque-territories-law.currentness: BOE consolidation labels latest update31 December 2021; consolidated text is informational.

basque-tax-agreement.instrument: Law 12/2002, Economic Agreement with the Basque Country
basque-tax-agreement.finding: Competent institutions of the historical territories may establish and regulate their territorial tax regimes.
basque-tax-agreement.currentness: Current BOE PDF indexed text read; full latest-amendment consolidation not certified.

araba-institution.instrument: Juntas Generales de Álava institutional account quoting Norma Foral 7 March 1983
araba-institution.finding: Identifies the Juntas as representative organ with normative power, election of the Diputado General, budget approval and executive control.
araba-institution.currentness: Maintained institutional page read24 October 2026; quoted core provision, not a complete contemporary law consolidation.

bizkaia-institution.instrument: Norma Foral 3/1987, election, organisation, regime and functioning of Bizkaia institutions
bizkaia-institution.finding: The Juntas exercise normative power, elect the Diputado General, approve budgets and control the Diputación; Normas Forales outrank executive decrees.
bizkaia-institution.currentness: November 2023 institutional compilation linked by current Juntas normative index; no complete 2026 amendment census.

gipuzkoa-institution.instrument: Norma Foral 6/2005, institutional organisation, government and administration of Gipuzkoa
gipuzkoa-institution.finding: The elected Juntas exercise normative power, choose the Diputado General, approve territorial budgets and control the executive; article 6 identifies the Normas Forales regime.
gipuzkoa-institution.currentness: Informational consolidation effective24 March 2021, expressly without official legal character. Core authority corroborates Basque statute/Law 27/1983; no claim of every 2026 amendment.

norway-sami-act.instrument: Sámi Act, official government English publication
norway-sami-act.finding: Combines elected representation, statements and referrals, grant administration/regulations, internal governance and statutory consultation; this is not a general territorial legislative jurisdiction.
norway-sami-act.currentness: Government publication dated2 July 2025 includes consultation chapter 4. Used for legal class, not all subsequent administrative delegations.

sweden-sami-act.finding: Defines a special agency focused on Sámi culture, grants, consultation, language, planning participation and other assigned tasks; elected plenum and accountable board are within that nonterritorial framework.
sweden-sami-act.currentness: Riksdag text explicitly amended through SFS 2026:136; current retrieved law, not an older reform proposal.

svalbard-law.finding: Local self-government applies to Longyearbyen’s planning area; the elected local council acts for that local entity.
svalbard-law.currentness: Indexed actual statute reviewed; direct reader unavailable. Current class corroborated by2023–24 government white paper; no complete 2026 consolidation claim.

svalbard-policy.finding: Council jurisdiction is limited to the Longyearbyen planning area. Its legal framework applies many Local Government Act provisions; the Governor is the government’s highest archipelago representative.
svalbard-policy.currentness: 2023–24 parliamentary white paper, read24 October 2026; municipal-like class, not current personnel verification.

luxembourg-constitution.instrument: Luxembourg Constitution, official Conseil d’État extracts
luxembourg-constitution.finding: The Council gives opinions. Refusal to agree to dispense with the Chamber’s second vote imposes a minimum three-month interval, rather than a Council law-adoption vote.
luxembourg-constitution.currentness: Explicit version in force1 July 2023, reviewed24 October 2026.

luxembourg-role.finding: Government describes Luxembourg as unicameral and recognises the Council’s real suspensive veto, exceeding ordinary consultation but not making it a second chamber.
luxembourg-role.currentness: Read on 24 October 2026; inventory and authority only.

luxembourg-council-law.instrument: Modified Law 16 June 2017 on organisation of the Conseil d’État
luxembourg-council-law.finding: Public plenary decisions agree or refuse the second-vote waiver; refusal must be reasoned.
luxembourg-council-law.currentness: Maintained modified-law text read24 October 2026; constitutional role corroborated by current official framework.

raeo-foundation.finding: Original scheme expressly excludes legislative competence; regional orders/regulations implement national law. Authority and consultative organs administer rather than form a regional parliament.
raeo-foundation.currentness: Original2014 text only; amended2019/2022/2023. Current organ classification is separately anchored in DL 1/2026, not this unamended text alone.

raeo-2026.finding: Current framework retains a deliberative Authority, executive President and Consultative Council under central tutelage; municipal administrative law supplies duties and subsidiary rules. Plans, budgeting and expenditure remain administratively supervised.
raeo-2026.currentness: Operative instrument2 February 2026, applying Law 3/2014 as amended through 18/2023. Article34 revokes DL 5/2015. No inference that its administrative autonomy creates a legislature.

atauro-foundation.finding: Creates a local administrative authority under ministerial tutelage. General Council supervises services and approves administrative plans/budgets for superior homologation; substantive local regulatory proposals go to the responsible minister.
atauro-foundation.currentness: Published23 November 2023; later ministerial implementation and current 2026 ministry directory corroborate continued administrative class. No complete amendment census.

atauro-implementation.finding: Homologates the General Council’s organisation rules and identifies the authority as a local state-administration service, implementing DL 82/2023.
atauro-implementation.currentness: Published5 June 2024, distinguishing administrative implementation from autonomous territorial legislation.

noronha-organic-law.instrument: Pernambuco Law 11.304/1995, Fernando de Noronha Organic Law
noronha-organic-law.finding: Elected district council advises, scrutinises, approves accounts and proposes legislation through the administrator/state process. The governor appoints the administrator and the district budget integrates Pernambuco’s budget law.
noronha-organic-law.currentness: District-hosted PDF includes amendments at least through March 2022; not represented as fully consolidated through 2026.

noronha-current-class.instrument: Fernando de Noronha institutional transparency page
noronha-current-class.finding: Describes the district as part of the state executive’s indirect administration, linked under Law 18.139/2023; lists the district council separately.
noronha-current-class.currentness: Maintained page read24 October 2026; its council roster is expressly2025, so no2026-personnel certification.

counting_note: Three additions are distinct foral institutions beneath one existing autonomous community. RAEOA’s Authority and Consultative Council are two excluded organs of one region; do not count them as two territories. Suggested IDs require root integration/deduplication.
bounded_review_limits: Not a certification of all 71 countries’ completeness or all2026 statutory amendments.
Australia/France/Chile remaining special-territory class notes are assigned to the parent; Papua assigned separately.
Metadata, institutional route accessibility, services, streams, EPG and media rights remain later-phase work.
